g.text: WiFi Kit 8 · ESP8266 · use GPIO numbers to identify signals
13 single-wire Dupont leads: power 2 · servo 3 · encoder 5 · sensor socket 3.
Without the sensor connection: 10 leads. The temperature probe cable is separate.
The cables are plugged in directly; some are soldered at one end at sockets and servo.
Dots indicate connections. Crossing lines without a dot are not connected.
OLED connected on-board; keep GPIO4, GPIO5 and GPIO16 reserved for it.
Board photo: included WiFi Kit 8 pinout document · cable routing schematic
